From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: Normale and normāle

English

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Italian normale (“normal”). Doublet of normal.

Noun

[edit]

normale (plural normales)

  1. A normal espresso drink, neither ristretto (shorter) nor lungo (longer).

Coordinate terms

[edit]
  • corto
  • lungo
  • ristretto

Anagrams

[edit]
  • Monreal, almoner, moneral, nemoral

Dutch

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Hyphenation: nor‧ma‧le

Adjective

[edit]

normale

  1. inflection of normaal:
    1. masculine/feminine singular attributive
    2. definite neuter singular attributive
    3. plural attributive

Esperanto

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /norˈmale/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ale
  • Syllabification: nor‧ma‧le

Adverb

[edit]

normale

  1. normally

French

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /nɔʁ.mal/
  • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)

Adjective

[edit]

normale

  1. feminine singular of normal

Noun

[edit]

normale f (plural normales)

  1. (geometry) Line perpendicular to a curve

Further reading

[edit]
  • “normale”, in Trésor de la langue française informatisé [Digitized Treasury of the French Language], 2012

German

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio (Germany (Berlin)):(file)

Adjective

[edit]

normale

  1. inflection of normal:
    1. strong/mixed nominative/accusative feminine singular
    2. strong nominative/accusative plural
    3. weak nominative all-gender singular
    4. weak accusative feminine/neuter singular

Ido

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From normala (“normal”) +‎ -e (adverbial ending).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /norˈmale/

Adverb

[edit]

normale

  1. normally

Related terms

[edit]
  • normala (“normal”)

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin nōrmālis.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /norˈma.le/
  • Rhymes: -ale
  • Hyphenation: nor‧mà‧le
  • Audio:(file)

Adjective

[edit]

normale m or f by sense (plural normali, superlative normalissimo)

  1. normal
    Antonym: anormale
  2. (with strada) shunpike

Derived terms

[edit]
  • centinormale
  • millinormale
  • normalizzare
  • normalmente
  • paranormale
  • subnormale

Related terms

[edit]
  • anormale
  • norma

Further reading

[edit]
  • normale in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

Anagrams

[edit]
  • merlano
